g.text: Left: taller bars mean the LLM more often chooses a pair that the classifier frequently confuses. The first suggestion is usually better targeted than the full list.
Right: taller bars mean that type of action is used more often. Models mostly push classes apart; none pulls classes together here. Tightening can happen at the same
